products.name: Local Television Broadcasting
products.description: Operation of 64 television stations and two radio stations in 51 U.S. markets, producing and delivering local news, sports, weather, and entertainment content via over-the-air broadcast, cable, satellite, and digital platforms. Content is created by in-house teams and distributed through regulated broadcast infrastructure and digital channels.

products.name: Digital Content and Streaming Services
products.description: Provision of local news, sports, and entertainment content through digital platforms including station websites, mobile apps, connected TV (CTV), streaming apps, and free ad-supported streaming television (FAST) channels. Content is produced in-house and delivered digitally to consumers on all devices.

products.name: Advertising and Marketing Services
products.description: Sales of advertising and marketing solutions across linear television, digital platforms (websites, mobile, CTV, streaming apps), and third-party streaming networks. Services include customized marketing campaigns, audience targeting, and analytics for local, regional, and national advertisers.

products.name: Political Advertising
products.description: Sales of advertising time to political candidates, parties, and advocacy groups on broadcast and digital platforms, primarily during election cycles. Delivered through regulated broadcast and digital infrastructure, leveraging broad audience reach.

products.name: Content Distribution and Licensing
products.description: Licensing of television content to multichannel video programming distributors (MVPDs), virtual MVPDs, and other third parties for retransmission or redistribution, generating fees based on subscriber counts and negotiated agreements. Involves regulated negotiations and contractual arrangements.

products.name: Premion Digital Advertising Platform
products.description: A turnkey digital advertising solution enabling local, regional, and national brands to run streaming CTV advertising campaigns across third-party streaming apps and CTV networks in all U.S. television markets. Delivered via proprietary digital platform and salesforce.

products.name: Multicast and Specialty Networks
products.description: Operation and distribution of multicast and specialty digital networks such as True Crime Network and Quest, providing genre-specific content to viewers via digital subchannels and online platforms. Content is delivered through broadcast and digital infrastructure.

products.name: Podcast Network
products.description: Production and distribution of podcasts through the Locked On Podcast Network, offering local and sports-focused audio content to digital audiences via online platforms.

products.name: Tower Rentals and Other Services
products.description: Provision of tower rental services and production of programming for third parties, leveraging physical broadcast infrastructure and production capabilities.

products.name: Crude Oil Production and Sales
products.description: Exploration, extraction, and production of crude oil from conventional basins in Colombia, Ecuador, and Canada, delivered via pipelines or trucking to marketers or export terminals. Requires significant physical infrastructure, drilling operations, and compliance with local regulations.

products.name: Natural Gas Production and Sales
products.description: Exploration, extraction, and production of natural gas, primarily in Canada, sold to marketers and aggregators. Involves drilling, processing, and pipeline transportation, subject to regulatory regimes.

products.name: Natural Gas Liquids (NGLs) Production and Sales
products.description: Production and sale of natural gas liquids (NGLs) such as condensate, primarily from Canadian operations, delivered via pipeline infrastructure to marketers. Requires specialized processing and handling.

products.name: Crude Oil Production and Sales
products.description: Production and sale of crude oil extracted from offshore wells in the Santa Ynez Unit (SYU), utilizing offshore platforms, onshore processing, and storage facilities. The process involves physical extraction, transportation via pipelines, and processing before sale to market.

products.name: Natural Gas Production and Sales
products.description: Production and sale of natural gas from offshore wells in the SYU, processed through onshore gas plants for sweetening, sulfur recovery, and fractionation before delivery to market. This involves physical extraction, processing, and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Crude Oil Transportation Services
products.description: Transportation of crude oil via the Santa Ynez Pipeline System (SYPS), including offshore and onshore pipelines (Segments 324 and 325), from production platforms to processing/storage facilities and onward to refinery markets. This service uses regulated, physical pipeline infrastructure.

products.name: Natural Gas Processing and Sales of Natural Gas Liquids (NGLs)
products.description: Processing of natural gas at onshore facilities to extract and sell natural gas liquids (NGLs) such as propane and butane, involving fractionation, gas sweetening, and compression. This is a physical, regulated process integrated with oil and gas production.

products.name: Produced Water Treatment Services
products.description: Treatment of produced water from oil and gas operations at onshore facilities, including oil removal, degassing, and biological treatment, using specialized physical and biological processes. Treated water may be disposed or reused per regulations.

products.name: Offshore Storage and Treating Vessel Services (Planned)
products.description: Planned provision of offshore storage and treating vessel (OS&T) services to store and treat crude oil offshore, enabling access to domestic and global markets via shuttle tankers. This involves acquisition, refitting, and operation of specialized vessels.

products.name: Cruise Vacations
products.description: Comprehensive cruise vacation packages offered through Royal Caribbean, Celebrity Cruises, Silversea, TUI Cruises, and Hapag-Lloyd Cruises, including accommodations, meals, entertainment, and a variety of onboard activities. These are delivered via a fleet of ships operating worldwide itineraries and require significant physical assets, regulated infrastructure, and in-person service.

products.name: Private Destination Experiences
products.description: Exclusive land-based vacation experiences at company-owned private destinations such as the Perfect Day and Royal Beach Club collections, featuring amenities like water parks, beaches, and curated activities. These are physically developed and operated by the company and are accessible only to cruise guests.

products.name: Onboard Services and Amenities
products.description: A wide array of onboard services and amenities sold to guests during cruises, including specialty dining, beverages, gaming, spa and fitness services, retail shops, internet access, and shore excursions. These are delivered through a mix of company operations and third-party concessionaires on the ships.

products.name: River Cruise Vacations
products.description: Premium river cruise vacation packages offered under the Celebrity River Cruises brand, featuring new river cruise ships and itineraries. These are physically operated vessels providing upscale accommodations and curated experiences along river routes.

products.name: Pre- and Post-Cruise Travel Packages
products.description: Travel packages that include hotel stays and tours before or after a cruise, arranged and sold to cruise guests. These packages are coordinated by the company and may include third-party hotel and tour services.

products.name: Cruise Vacation Protection Coverage
products.description: Insurance products sold to guests in select markets, providing coverage for trip cancellation, medical protection, and baggage protection related to cruise vacations. These are financial products underwritten by third parties and sold as add-ons to cruise bookings.

products.name: Port Facilities and Management Services
products.description: Operation, development, and management of cruise terminal facilities and port infrastructure in key ports, sometimes through joint ventures or partnerships. These services are delivered through physical infrastructure investments and management expertise.

products.name: Corporate Collateralized Loan Obligation (CLO) Investments
products.description: Investments in mezzanine debt and equity tranches of corporate CLOs, which are securitizations backed primarily by non-investment grade, first lien, senior secured corporate bank loans. These are financial products acquired and managed through capital allocation and portfolio management, not physical manufacturing.

products.name: CLO Warehouse Facility Investments (Loan Accumulation Facilities)
products.description: Investments in CLO warehouse facilities (LAFs), which are short- to medium-term financing vehicles that acquire corporate loans in anticipation of forming a CLO. These are financial investments managed through capital deployment and structuring, not physical production.

products.name: Other Securitized Corporate Credit Investments
products.description: Investments in securities issued by other securitization vehicles, such as collateralized bond obligations (CBOs), and related corporate debt and equity assets. These are financial products acquired and managed through investment and trading activities.

products.name: Acute Care Hospital Services
products.description: Comprehensive inpatient and outpatient medical and surgical care delivered through 30 acute care hospitals, including emergency, internal medicine, general surgery, cardiology, oncology, orthopedics, women’s services, neurology, and urology. Services are provided by in-person human labor, regulated infrastructure, and advanced medical technology.

products.name: Ambulatory and Outpatient Services
products.description: A broad network of ambulatory facilities providing outpatient care, including primary and specialty care clinics, ambulatory surgery centers, urgent care centers, diagnostic imaging centers, and free-standing emergency departments. Services are delivered in-person by medical professionals in regulated outpatient settings.

products.name: Physician Services
products.description: Medical care provided by a network of over 2,000 employed and affiliated physicians and advanced practice providers, including both primary care and specialist services, delivered in hospitals, clinics, and other care settings. Requires in-person human labor and regulated professional practice.

products.name: Telehealth and Virtual Care Services
products.description: Remote healthcare services including virtual visits, remote patient monitoring, and chronic care management, delivered via digital platforms and supported by advanced technology and AI-enabled tools. Services are provided digitally, extending care beyond physical facilities.

products.name: Rehabilitation Services
products.description: Inpatient and outpatient rehabilitation services provided through dedicated rehabilitation hospitals and programs, utilizing specialized staff and facilities to deliver physical, occupational, and related therapies. Requires regulated infrastructure and skilled human labor.

products.name: Surgical Services
products.description: Surgical procedures performed in both hospital and ambulatory surgery center settings, including general and specialty surgeries. Delivered by surgical teams using regulated facilities and advanced medical equipment.

products.name: Diagnostic Imaging Services
products.description: Medical imaging services such as MRI, CT, X-ray, and other diagnostic procedures provided through dedicated imaging centers and hospital-based facilities. Requires specialized equipment and trained personnel.

products.name: Urgent Care Services
products.description: Walk-in medical care for non-life-threatening conditions provided through urgent care centers, offering extended hours and convenient access. Delivered by medical professionals in regulated outpatient settings.

products.name: Orthopoxvirus Vaccines (GEO-MVA)
products.description: Vaccines targeting mpox, smallpox, and other orthopoxviruses, developed using a proprietary Modified Vaccinia Ankara (MVA) platform. Manufactured via third-party contract manufacturing organizations, with a transition toward scalable, continuous cell-line production for commercial supply.

products.name: Oncolytic Solid Tumor Gene Therapy (Gedeptin)
products.description: Gene-directed enzyme prodrug therapy (GDEPT) for the treatment of solid tumors, especially head and neck cancers. Delivered via intra-tumoral injection of a replication-deficient adenovirus vector, followed by systemic administration of a prodrug.

products.name: COVID-19 Vaccines (GEO-CM04S1)
products.description: Next-generation, multi-antigen COVID-19 vaccines based on a synthetic MVA vector expressing both spike and nucleocapsid proteins. Developed for use as primary and booster vaccines, particularly targeting immunocompromised and high-risk populations.

products.name: Hemorrhagic Fever Virus Vaccines (Ebola, Sudan, Marburg)
products.description: Vaccines for Ebola Zaire, Ebola Sudan, and Marburg viruses, utilizing the GV-MVA-VLP™ platform to express viral proteins and induce immune responses. Currently in preclinical development, with manufacturing via third-party partners.

products.name: HEPZATO KIT (melphalan for Injection/Hepatic Delivery System)
products.description: A combination drug and device product that delivers high-dose melphalan chemotherapy directly to the liver via a proprietary hepatic delivery system, primarily for the treatment of adult patients with uveal melanoma with unresectable hepatic metastases. The product is physically manufactured, requires regulated infrastructure, and is administered in a clinical setting by trained professionals.

products.name: CHEMOSAT Hepatic Delivery System for Melphalan
products.description: A stand-alone medical device system approved in Europe for percutaneous hepatic perfusion procedures, enabling the regional delivery of high-dose melphalan chemotherapy to the liver for a wide range of primary and metastatic liver cancers. The system is physically manufactured, regulated as a Class III medical device, and used in hospital settings by interventional radiologists.

products.name: Discrete Semiconductor Products
products.description: Manufactured semiconductor components such as MOSFETs, SiC MOSFETs, protection devices, diodes, rectifiers, and bipolar transistors, produced using wafer fabrication and assembly/test facilities and delivered in various package types for integration into electronic systems.

products.name: Analog Semiconductor Products
products.description: Analog integrated circuits including power management devices, linear devices, LED drivers, audio amplifiers, and sensor products, designed and manufactured using proprietary processes and advanced packaging for use in power conversion, signal amplification, and sensing applications.

products.name: Mixed-Signal Semiconductor Products
products.description: Integrated circuits combining analog and digital functions, such as high speed mux/demux, digital switches, interface ICs, redrivers, level shifters, clock ICs, and packet switches, produced using advanced semiconductor design and manufacturing processes for use in data communication and signal processing.

products.name: Standard Logic Semiconductor Products
products.description: Standard logic integrated circuits such as CMOS and advanced high-speed CMOS devices, ultra-low power logic, and analog switches, manufactured for use in digital control and signal routing in electronic systems.

products.name: Multichip and Co-Packaged Semiconductor Solutions
products.description: Miniature packages integrating multiple discrete, analog, and mixed-signal chips into a single product, leveraging proprietary packaging technology to deliver higher functionality and reduced component count for OEMs.

products.name: Silicon and Silicon Epitaxial Wafers
products.description: Manufactured silicon and silicon epitaxial wafers used as substrates for semiconductor device fabrication, produced in-house and supplied to support internal and external semiconductor manufacturing needs.

products.name: Frequency Control Products (FCP)
products.description: Electronic components such as crystals and crystal oscillators that provide frequency references for timing and synchronization in automotive, industrial, computing, communication, and consumer electronics, manufactured using specialized processes and supplied as discrete components.

products.name: Contact Image Sensor (CIS) Modules
products.description: Integrated sensor modules combining sensor ICs, illumination, and rod lenses, manufactured for use in high-speed copy machines, check scanners, banknote validators, and industrial inspection equipment.

products.name: Advanced Voice Processing Semiconductor Solutions
products.description: Semiconductor products and solutions providing advanced voice processing technologies to enhance human-to-human and human-to-machine voice communication, primarily targeted at automotive and computer markets, developed through proprietary design and acquired technology.

products.name: Casualty Insurance
products.description: Primary and excess general liability and environmental liability insurance for commercial clients, including coverage for bodily injury, property damage, and pollution risks. Delivered through experienced underwriters using a craft underwriting model and distributed primarily via wholesale channels.

products.name: Professional Liability Insurance
products.description: Admitted and E&S professional liability insurance products for a broad range of entities, including management liability (D&O, E&O, EPL, fiduciary, fidelity), crime, and cyber liability. Delivered primarily through the craft underwriting model, with some small cyber and miscellaneous professional liability products offered digitally.

products.name: Healthcare Liability Insurance
products.description: Professional, general, and management liability insurance for healthcare entities, including hospitals, medical facilities, senior care providers, and managed care organizations. Delivered through the craft underwriting model and distributed via select wholesale and retail channels.

products.name: Small Business E&S Insurance (Baleen Specialty)
products.description: Non-admitted general liability insurance for small to mid-sized, distressed, or hard-to-place risks, primarily in construction and real estate. Delivered through a technology-powered digital underwriting model and distributed exclusively via wholesale channels.

products.name: Zero Trust Exchange Platform
products.description: A cloud-native, multitenant security platform implementing Zero Trust principles to securely connect users, devices, applications, and workloads, replacing traditional firewalls and VPNs. Delivered as a SaaS platform, it provides security and policy enforcement at global scale.

products.name: Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA)
products.description: A cloud-delivered secure internet and SaaS access service providing threat protection, data loss prevention, and policy enforcement for users accessing external applications, using AI/ML for threat detection and delivered as a SaaS solution.

products.name: Zscaler Private Access (ZPA)
products.description: A cloud-based Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) service enabling secure, policy-driven access to internally managed applications in data centers or clouds, without exposing applications to the internet or requiring VPNs.

products.name: Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX)
products.description: A SaaS-based digital experience monitoring and analytics solution that measures and optimizes end-to-end user experience across applications, leveraging AI for root cause analysis and proactive remediation.

products.name: Zero Trust Cloud Security
products.description: A cloud-native solution for securing customer workloads across hybrid environments (public clouds and private data centers), providing centralized policy enforcement, threat and data protection, and workload microsegmentation.

products.name: Zero Trust Branch Security
products.description: A solution applying Zero Trust principles to secure communications between and within branches, factories, and campuses, including Zero Trust SD-WAN and device segmentation, delivered via cloud-managed appliances or virtual machines.

products.name: Data Security Everywhere
products.description: A suite of cloud-delivered data security services including data loss prevention (DLP), advanced AI-powered data classification, SaaS security posture management, email security, and data security posture management, protecting data across its lifecycle and locations.

products.name: Security for AI Applications
products.description: A portfolio of security solutions for public and private AI applications, including GenAI security, AI Guard for users and LLMs, and AI decoys, providing visibility, policy enforcement, and protection against AI-specific threats and data leakage.

products.name: Agentic Security Operations
products.description: A set of cloud-based security operations solutions including exposure management, unified vulnerability management, asset exposure management, deception technologies, identity protection, and managed detection and response, leveraging AI and automation to reduce cyber risk.

products.name: Agentic IT Operations
products.description: An AI-driven IT operations solution (via ZDX) providing predictive analytics, automated root cause analysis, and agentic remediation to improve digital experience, reduce downtime, and lower IT operations costs.

products.name: Less-Than-Truckload (LTL) Freight Transportation
products.description: Provides standard, time-critical, and guaranteed LTL freight transportation services for general commodities across North America, utilizing a network of local pickup and delivery service centers and larger distribution facilities. Requires significant physical infrastructure, real estate, and in-person labor.

products.name: Truckload Brokerage Services
products.description: Offers third-party truckload transportation brokerage, sourcing capacity solutions such as dry van, temperature-controlled, flatbed, intermodal, and specialized equipment through a network of contract carriers. Delivered digitally and via logistics professionals, leveraging technology and web tools.

products.name: Managed Transportation Solutions
products.description: Partners with customers to design and execute logistics strategies, optimizing supply chains through technology, analytics, and operational expertise. Delivered as a service combining digital platforms and logistics professionals, often integrating multiple transportation modes.

products.name: Expedited Freight Transportation and Premium Logistics
products.description: Provides expedited freight transportation and premium logistics services, including rapid deployment of specialized equipment for time-sensitive, high-security, temperature-controlled, and government cargo. Utilizes a mix of owned fleet and third-party carriers, with advanced tracking and security features.

products.name: International Ocean and Air Freight Forwarding
products.description: Delivers global shipping solutions by arranging ocean and air freight transportation, acting as a non-vessel operating common carrier and freight forwarder. Includes ground transportation to and from ports and warehousing/distribution at major global ports. Relies on partnerships with global carriers.

products.name: Household Goods Moving Services
products.description: Provides household moving services under the U-Pack brand, targeting 'do-it-yourself' consumers with flexible, containerized moving solutions. Uses company-owned trailers and containers transported by ABF Freight, delivered at competitive prices.

products.name: Other Logistics Services (Final Mile, Warehousing, Retail Logistics, Trade Show Shipping)
products.description: Offers a suite of ancillary logistics services including final mile delivery, time-critical shipments, warehousing and distribution, retail logistics, supply chain optimization, brokered LTL, and trade show shipping. Delivered through a mix of digital solutions and logistics professionals, often leveraging third-party providers.

products.name: Premium Metal Payment Cards
products.description: CompoSecure designs and manufactures premium metal payment cards that integrate metal cores with EMV chips, magnetic stripes, and contactless payment technology, using advanced materials science and proprietary manufacturing processes. These are physical products delivered to financial institutions and card issuers.

products.name: Secure Authentication Solutions
products.description: CompoSecure provides secure authentication solutions, leveraging its expertise in advanced materials and security technologies to deliver products that help issuers and consumers authenticate transactions. These are technology-driven solutions delivered to external customers.

products.name: Injection Molding Equipment
products.description: Husky manufactures highly engineered injection molding equipment used in the production of food, beverage, medical devices, general packaging, closures, thinwall packaging, and consumer products. These are large, precision-engineered physical systems delivered to manufacturers globally.

products.name: Aftermarket Tooling and Services for Injection Molding
products.description: Husky provides aftermarket tooling, parts, and services to support the lifecycle of its injection molding equipment, including maintenance, upgrades, and replacement parts. These services are delivered directly to customers using Husky equipment.

products.name: Floating Rate Loans to Middle-Market Companies
products.description: Origination and investment in floating rate loans, primarily first lien secured debt, to U.S. middle-market companies. These loans are typically below investment grade and are structured, negotiated, and managed by the company and its investment adviser. Delivery requires financial capital, credit expertise, and ongoing portfolio management.

products.name: Second Lien Secured Debt and Subordinated Debt Investments
products.description: Provision of second lien secured debt and subordinated debt to middle-market companies, which are junior to first lien debt and often unsecured. These investments are structured to earn higher returns due to higher risk and may include equity participation features. Delivery requires financial structuring, risk assessment, and ongoing monitoring.

products.name: Equity Investments in Portfolio Companies
products.description: Minority equity investments, including direct equity stakes and warrants, in portfolio companies, often as part of debt transactions. These are typically ancillary to debt investments and may provide additional upside. Delivery is through negotiated transactions and may involve registration rights and other protective provisions.

products.name: Specialty Insurance Products
products.description: Markel Insurance provides a broad range of specialty insurance products, including general liability, professional liability, personal lines, marine and energy, property, specialty programs, workers' compensation, and credit and surety. These products are underwritten and delivered through wholesale, retail, and program channels, both in the U.S. and internationally, requiring regulated infrastructure and significant underwriting expertise.

products.name: Insurance Fronting Services
products.description: Through State National and Markel Insurance, the company provides fronting services, writing insurance policies on behalf of other carriers or capacity providers who lack required licenses or ratings. This service is delivered via licensed insurance subsidiaries and involves regulatory compliance and risk management.

products.name: Reinsurance Products (Run-off)
products.description: Markel Insurance previously offered casualty and specialty reinsurance products globally, including professional liability, general liability, marine and energy, workers compensation, and credit and surety. This business is now in run-off, with existing contracts being managed to completion.

products.name: Industrial Building Products Distribution
products.description: Lansing Building Products distributes exterior building products such as siding, windows, doors, roofing, and gutters to professional contractors and builders, operating a network of branches and providing inventory and logistical support. This is a physical distribution business requiring warehousing and logistics.

products.name: Precast Concrete Products
products.description: Metromont manufactures structural and architectural precast concrete products for construction projects, serving general contractors in commercial, infrastructure, and multi-family building markets. Production involves physical manufacturing at multiple plants.

products.name: Fire Protection and Security Services
products.description: VSC Fire & Security provides fire protection, life safety, and low-voltage solutions, including installation, inspection, and maintenance of fire and security systems for commercial clients. Services are delivered through a network of locations and require specialized human labor and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Car-Hauling Equipment Manufacturing
products.description: Cottrell manufactures over-the-road car-hauling trailers, offering customized solutions for commercial fleets and independent haulers. Production is based at a dedicated manufacturing facility and involves physical fabrication and engineering.

products.name: Industrial Bakery Equipment Manufacturing
products.description: AMF Bakery Systems and Reading Bakery Systems manufacture industrial bakery equipment for large-scale bakers and snack food producers, providing equipment from mixing to packaging. Products are manufactured at facilities in the U.S., Canada, Europe, and China.

products.name: HeavyLift Crane Services
products.description: Buckner HeavyLift Cranes provides specialized heavylift crawler crane services to large commercial contractors in sectors such as wind energy, infrastructure, and data centers. Services include crane rental and operation, requiring a specialized fleet and skilled operators.

products.name: Trailer Flooring Manufacturing
products.description: Havco manufactures laminated oak and composite flooring for dry van trailers, supplying original equipment manufacturers. Production is conducted at dedicated manufacturing facilities and involves material processing and fabrication.

products.name: Erosion Control and Stormwater Management Solutions
products.description: Valor Environmental provides erosion control and stormwater management services, primarily for construction and land development projects. Services are delivered on-site and require compliance with environmental regulations.

products.name: Dredging Equipment Manufacturing
products.description: Ellicott Dredges designs and manufactures cutter suction and auger dredges for marine and waterway applications. Products are physically manufactured and require engineering expertise.

products.name: Gas Containment and Transportation Equipment
products.description: Weldship manufactures equipment for gas containment and transportation, serving industrial and commercial customers. Production involves specialized fabrication and safety compliance.

products.name: Wall Panel Systems and Dorm Furniture Manufacturing
products.description: Panel Specialists manufactures wall panel systems and dorm room furniture for institutional and commercial clients, involving physical manufacturing and customization.

products.name: Insurance-Linked Securities Investment Management
products.description: Nephila provides insurance-linked securities (ILS) investment and insurance management services to institutional investors, offering alternative capital to insurance and reinsurance markets. Services are delivered digitally and through financial structuring, generating management fees.

products.name: Asset and Wealth Management Investment
products.description: Rosemont Investment Group invests in asset and wealth management companies, providing capital and strategic support. This is a financial investment business, not a service to external customers, but Rosemont's investments may include management services.

products.name: Ornamental Plant Production
products.description: Costa Farms produces ornamental plants for sale to large national retailers, operating greenhouses and cultivation facilities. This is a large-scale agricultural production business requiring physical facilities and distribution logistics.

products.name: Information Technology Consulting Services
products.description: CapTech provides information technology consulting services, including digital transformation, data analytics, and systems integration, to clients across various industries. Services are delivered by skilled consultants and project teams.

products.name: Homebuilding
products.description: Eagle Construction of Virginia builds detached single-family homes, townhouses, and condominiums, primarily in Virginia. The business involves land development, construction, and sales to homebuyers.

products.name: Leather Handbags and Accessories Design and Retail
products.description: Brahmin designs and sells leather handbags and accessories through retail stores, department stores, and online channels. Products are designed in-house and manufactured for sale to consumers.

products.name: Manufactured Housing Community Operations
products.description: Parkland Ventures owns and operates manufactured housing communities, providing residential rental services and property management.

products.name: International Teacher Placement Services
products.description: Educational Partners International sponsors and places international teachers in U.S. schools, handling recruitment, placement, and compliance.

products.name: Retail Data Collection and Pricing Intelligence Solutions
products.description: RDSolutions provides data collection and pricing intelligence solutions for retailers and brands, delivered through digital platforms and analytics services.

products.name: Concierge Healthcare Membership Services
products.description: PartnerMD offers concierge healthcare membership services, including primary care, executive health, and wellness programs, delivered through medical professionals and clinics.

products.name: Insulin Pump Systems
products.description: Durable, programmable insulin pumps (t:slim X2 and Tandem Mobi) designed for years of daily use, featuring advanced hybrid closed-loop technology and integration with continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) sensors. Manufactured at company facilities and delivered through direct sales and distributors.

products.name: Insulin Pump Supplies
products.description: Single-use supplies compatible with Tandem insulin pumps, including cartridges for storing insulin and infusion sets for insulin delivery, replaced every few days. Cartridges are manufactured in-house or by contract manufacturers; infusion sets are sourced from third-party suppliers.

products.name: Automated Insulin Delivery (AID) Algorithms
products.description: Proprietary software algorithms (Control-IQ and Control-IQ+) that automate insulin dosing by integrating pump and CGM data, available globally and embedded in Tandem pump systems. Delivered as part of the pump system and via software updates.

products.name: Diabetes Data Management Platforms
products.description: Web-based and mobile platforms (Tandem Source and Sugarmate) that aggregate, visualize, and report diabetes therapy data from pumps and CGMs for users, caregivers, and healthcare providers. Delivered digitally and accessible globally.

products.name: Pump Software Update Tools
products.description: PC and Mac-compatible software (Tandem Device Updater) that allows users to update their pump software remotely, provided at no cost to in-warranty customers. Delivered digitally for use with Tandem pumps.

products.name: Term Loans
products.description: Provision of secured term loans to growth-oriented companies, typically structured with interest-only periods and amortizing over up to 60 months. These loans are originated, underwritten, and managed by in-house professionals and require significant financial capital and risk assessment expertise.

products.name: Equipment Financings
products.description: Provision of equipment financing to growth-oriented companies, involving loans secured by specific equipment or other assets, typically fully amortizing over up to 60 months. This product requires asset evaluation, collateral management, and financial structuring expertise.

products.name: Asset-Based Lending
products.description: Provision of asset-based loans to growth-oriented companies, secured by company assets and structured to meet specific capital needs. This product line involves collateral evaluation and ongoing monitoring of asset values.

products.name: Working Capital Loans
products.description: Provision of working capital loans to growth-oriented companies, structured to support operational liquidity and short-term financial needs. These loans are typically secured and require ongoing credit monitoring.

products.name: Equity and Equity-Related Investments
products.description: Acquisition of equity and equity-related securities (such as warrants) in portfolio companies, often in conjunction with debt investments. This product involves negotiating equity positions and managing potential capital appreciation opportunities.

products.name: Investment Advisory Services
products.description: Provision of investment advisory and related services to third-party investment vehicles through a registered investment adviser subsidiary, generating fee income. This is a service business requiring regulatory compliance and investment management expertise.

products.name: Automotive Financing Services
products.description: UACC provides indirect vehicle financing to consumers through a nationwide network of independent and manufacturer-franchised used motor vehicle dealers, primarily targeting non-prime and near-prime credit segments. The service is delivered via a combination of automated underwriting, digital dealer portals, and in-person and remote sales representatives, and is subject to extensive financial regulation.

products.name: Vehicle Service Contracts (VSCs) Financing and Administration
products.description: UACC finances the purchase of Vehicle Service Contracts, which provide protection for consumers by covering certain mechanical-related issues with vehicles. UACC works with third-party administrators to underwrite and administer these contracts, earning fees and finance charges on the amounts financed.

products.name: Guaranteed Asset Protection (GAP) Products
products.description: UACC sells, administers, and finances Guaranteed Asset Protection products, which help protect customers in the event of a total vehicle loss when insurance payouts are insufficient. UACC offers both its own GAP product and finances third-party GAP products, earning income from finance charges and product sales.

products.name: Automotive Data Analytics and Digital Services
products.description: CarStory provides AI-powered analytics and digital services to automotive dealers, financial services companies, and others, including vehicle market reports, pricing optimization, and digital consumer experiences. These services are delivered digitally, leveraging a proprietary vehicle information database and advanced data science models.

products.name: Merchant Payment Processing Solutions
products.description: Provides full-service acquiring and payment-enabled solutions for B2C transactions, including card, ACH, check, and wire payments, delivered via proprietary software platforms and distributed through ISOs, direct sales, and ISV channels. Solutions are cloud-based and support in-person, online, and mobile payment acceptance.

products.name: Accounts Payable Automation Solutions
products.description: Offers automated accounts payable (AP) solutions to businesses and financial institutions, enabling electronic payments to suppliers via virtual card, purchase card, ACH, dynamic discounting, wire, and check, with features for cash flow acceleration and rebate/discount management. Delivered through proprietary platforms such as CPX and Plastiq.

products.name: Embedded Finance and Treasury Solutions
products.description: Delivers embedded finance and Banking-as-a-Service (BaaS) solutions that allow software partners and business platforms to integrate banking, payments, account ledgering, and money movement (collect, store, lend, send) into their own systems via APIs. Includes management of deposits and reconciliation for marketplaces and platforms.

products.name: Business Management and Value-Added Merchant Applications
products.description: Provides a suite of technology-enabled business management tools and value-added applications for merchants, including analytics (MX Insights), e-commerce and POS solutions (MX Storefront, MX Retail), invoicing (MX Invoice), and ACH payment handling (ACH.com), all integrated with core payment processing.

products.name: Merchant Onboarding, Underwriting, and Risk Management Tools
products.description: Offers automated tools for merchant onboarding, underwriting, risk management, and client service, primarily through the MX Connect platform, enabling resellers and partners to efficiently activate and manage merchants with integrated compliance and risk controls.

products.name: Commercial Banking and Money Transmission Services
products.description: Provides banking and money transmission services, including the storage of customer funds in FDIC-eligible accounts, leveraging proprietary ledgering technology and partnerships with multiple banks to maximize insurance coverage and facilitate secure money movement.

products.name: Precision Power Conversion Products
products.description: Highly engineered power conversion products that transform and refine raw electrical power into controllable, predictable, and customizable power for complex equipment. These products are physically manufactured in global factories and delivered to OEMs and end users across multiple industries.

products.name: Plasma Power Products for Semiconductor Equipment
products.description: Plasma power solutions specifically designed for semiconductor manufacturing processes such as dry etch and deposition. These are manufactured products integrated into semiconductor equipment for advanced processing applications.

products.name: High Voltage Power Products
products.description: High voltage power supplies and related products used in semiconductor, industrial, medical, and other applications requiring specialized, reliable high-voltage power. These are manufactured and sold to OEMs and end users.

products.name: System Power Solutions for Data Center Computing
products.description: Power conversion and management solutions designed for data center server and storage systems, including high-density, high-efficiency power shelves and server rack power solutions. These are manufactured and integrated into data center infrastructure.

products.name: Application-Specific Power Conversion Products for Telecom and Networking
products.description: Custom power conversion products tailored for telecom and networking equipment, including wireless infrastructure and computer networking devices. These are manufactured and supplied to OEMs in the telecom sector.

products.name: Sensing, Control, and Instrumentation Products
products.description: Measurement, calibration, and control products for power and temperature, primarily for industrial, medical, and semiconductor markets. These are manufactured devices that complement power solutions and enable advanced process control.

products.name: Repair, Maintenance, and Refurbishment Services
products.description: Aftermarket services including repair, calibration, conversions, upgrades, refurbishments, and provision of used equipment for the company’s installed base of products. Delivered through a global network of service support centers.

products.name: Digital Label and Packaging Printing Systems
products.description: AstroNova designs, manufactures, and markets a range of digital color label and packaging printers, including tabletop, light commercial, direct-to-package, and high-volume presses, as well as OEM printing systems. These are physical hardware products delivered to brand owners, commercial printers, and OEMs for on-demand product marking, branding, and labeling applications.

products.name: Label, Tag, and Printing Supplies
products.description: AstroNova supplies a broad range of consumables including labels, tags, ink, and toner, which are used with its printing systems. These are physical products manufactured or sourced and sold to customers for use in marking, tracking, and enhancing the appearance of their products.

products.name: Label and Print Management Software
products.description: AstroNova develops and licenses specialized software for designing and managing labels, print images, and operating printers and presses, including automation and machine monitoring solutions. These are digital products delivered as software licenses or integrated with hardware.

products.name: Aerospace Airborne Printers
products.description: AstroNova designs and manufactures ruggedized flight deck and cabin printers, including the ToughWriter series and other acquired product lines, for use in commercial and military aircraft. These are physical hardware products built to meet stringent aerospace standards and are delivered to aircraft manufacturers and operators.

products.name: Aerospace Networking Hardware
products.description: AstroNova produces ruggedized Ethernet networking products, such as the ToughSwitch Ethernet switches, primarily for military aircraft and vehicles. These are physical hardware products designed to connect multiple computers or Ethernet devices in harsh aerospace environments.

products.name: Aerospace Data Acquisition and Recording Systems
products.description: AstroNova manufactures high-speed data acquisition systems and digital strip chart recorders for aerospace, defense, automotive, energy, and manufacturing industries. These physical hardware systems acquire, record, process, and present data from sensors and networked streams for R&D, flight testing, and production monitoring.

products.name: Training and Support Services
products.description: AstroNova provides worldwide training and support services for its hardware and software products, assisting customers in installation, operation, and maintenance. These are in-person and remote services delivered to end users and channel partners.

products.name: Money Market Investment Management
products.description: Management of money market funds and separate accounts, including government, prime, and municipal (tax-exempt) categories, primarily for institutions and retail investors. Delivered through regulated investment vehicles and requires significant financial and regulatory infrastructure.

products.name: Equity Investment Management
products.description: Active management of equity funds and separate accounts across value, growth, international/global, and blended strategies for institutional and retail clients. Delivered via mutual funds, ETFs, and separate accounts, requiring portfolio management and research expertise.

products.name: Fixed-Income Investment Management
products.description: Management of fixed-income funds and separate accounts, including multisector, high-yield, municipal, U.S. corporate, U.S. government, international/global, and mortgage-backed securities. Delivered through mutual funds, ETFs, and separate accounts, requiring credit analysis and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Alternative and Private Markets Investment Management
products.description: Management of alternative and private markets funds and accounts, including real estate, private equity, private credit, infrastructure, and other alternatives. Delivered through specialized funds and separate accounts, requiring expertise in illiquid and complex assets.

products.name: Multi-Asset Investment Management
products.description: Management of multi-asset funds and accounts that invest across asset classes, including equity, fixed-income, and alternatives. Delivered through mutual funds and separate accounts, requiring asset allocation and risk management expertise.

products.name: Stewardship and Engagement Services
products.description: Provision of stewardship services, including engagement with portfolio companies on governance, environmental, and social issues, to institutional clients seeking responsible investment solutions. Delivered as a service leveraging proprietary research and engagement teams.

products.name: Real Estate Development Services
products.description: Development and management of real estate projects for external clients, including investment in and management of real estate assets. Delivered through specialized teams and project management capabilities.

products.name: Renewable Energy Project Development Services
products.description: Development of renewable energy projects for external clients, involving project management, financing, and regulatory compliance. Delivered through specialized teams with expertise in energy infrastructure.

products.name: Fund Administration and Shareholder Servicing
products.description: Provision of administrative and shareholder servicing for investment funds, including recordkeeping, reporting, and client support. Delivered under service agreements with funds, requiring operational infrastructure and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Fund Distribution Services
products.description: Distribution and marketing of investment funds, including acting as underwriter and distributing fund shares through broker/dealers and financial intermediaries. Delivered via a dedicated sales force and distribution agreements.

products.name: Less-Lethal Personal Security Launchers
products.description: Handheld and shoulder-fired CO2-powered launchers (e.g., Byrna SD, CL, LE, LE PRO, TCR, M-4) designed and manufactured for consumers and professional security customers, providing less-lethal alternatives to firearms. These devices are physically manufactured, assembled, and tested in the U.S. and sold through retail, e-commerce, and professional channels.

products.name: Less-Lethal Projectiles
products.description: A line of proprietary projectiles (chemical irritant, kinetic, inert, Eco-Kinetic, and 12-gauge kinetic rounds) engineered and manufactured for use with Byrna launchers and compatible platforms, including both consumable and training rounds. These are produced at dedicated ammunition facilities and sold as recurring consumables.

products.name: Self-Defense Aerosol Sprays
products.description: Professional-grade defensive sprays (e.g., Fox Labs International, Byrna Bad Guy Repellent) formulated and manufactured for law enforcement and consumer markets, distributed through e-commerce and retail channels. These are chemical irritant sprays meeting professional standards.

products.name: Accessories for Launchers and Personal Security
products.description: A range of accessories (e.g., holsters, optics, magazines, CO2 cartridges, laser sights, flashlight attachments, barrel extensions, EDC gear bundles) designed and manufactured to enhance, customize, and maintain Byrna launchers and support user safety. These are physical products sold alongside launchers and projectiles.

products.name: Ballistic Protection Products
products.description: Ballistic-rated backpacks (e.g., Byrna Shield) and related armor panels, physically manufactured and sold to provide personal protection from ballistic threats. These products utilize patented deployment systems and are marketed to both consumers and professionals.

products.name: Branded Apparel
products.description: Byrna-branded apparel featuring the company’s logo and Live Safe motto, sold as lifestyle merchandise to promote brand engagement. These are physical clothing items sold through retail and e-commerce channels.

products.name: Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG) Sales
products.description: Production and sale of LNG through long-term, spot, short-term, and medium-term agreements, utilizing large-scale liquefaction facilities and associated storage and shipping infrastructure. LNG is produced by liquefying natural gas at the Rio Grande LNG Facility and delivered to customers via LNG carriers.

products.name: LNG Export Terminal Services
products.description: Provision of LNG export terminal services, including liquefaction, storage, and vessel loading at the Rio Grande LNG Facility, leveraging physical infrastructure such as liquefaction trains, storage tanks, and marine berths. These services enable third parties to export LNG to global markets.

products.name: LNG Shipping Services
products.description: Provision of LNG shipping capacity through time charter agreements and potential subchartering of vessels, enabling delivery of LNG to customers on a delivered ex-ship basis. This involves securing and managing LNG carrier vessels for transportation.

products.name: Carbon Capture and Storage (CCS) Services (Potential/Future)
products.description: Development and potential future offering of carbon capture and storage services at the Rio Grande LNG Facility, involving regulated infrastructure to capture and store CO2 emissions from LNG operations. This is currently under evaluation and permitting.

products.name: AppFolio Property Management Platform
products.description: A unified, cloud-based software platform for property management companies, providing core accounting, business intelligence, workflow automation, and data management. Delivered as a SaaS solution with AI-powered features and API integrations for extensibility.

products.name: Marketing and Leasing Automation Tools
products.description: Digital tools integrated into the platform to automate and manage the full leasing lifecycle, including AI-driven prospect engagement, lead qualification, tour scheduling, leasing CRM, and pricing optimization. Delivered via web and mobile interfaces.

products.name: Maintenance Management Solutions
products.description: Automated, digital maintenance workflow tools for property managers, including AI-powered service request intake, triage, work order generation, and unit turn management. Delivered through the platform with real-time communication features.

products.name: Electronic Payment Services
products.description: Online payment processing services for property managers, enabling electronic collection and disbursement of funds (rent, fees, dues, vendor payments) via secure web and mobile portals. Integrates with the core platform for streamlined receivables and payables.

products.name: Tenant Screening Services
products.description: Comprehensive digital tenant screening services, including credit, criminal, landlord-tenant, income, employment, and identity verification, integrated into the rental application process. Delivered via the FolioScreen Trusted Renter suite.

products.name: Risk Mitigation and Insurance Services
products.description: Risk mitigation products for property managers and residents, including insurance compliance tracking and renters insurance, provided through software tools and licensed insurance brokerage. Delivered via the FolioGuard suite and AppFolio Insurance Services.

products.name: Resident Experience Services
products.description: Digital services and mobile portals to enhance resident engagement, including onboarding, communication, and integration with third-party partners for additional resident offerings. Delivered through the platform and mobile applications.

products.name: Communication and Customer Service Tools
products.description: Integrated communication tools for property managers to manage resident, owner, and investor correspondence via centralized inboxes, supporting text and email within the platform's workflows. Designed to improve service efficiency and record-keeping.

products.name: Third-Party Integration Marketplace (AppFolio Stack)
products.description: A digital marketplace and API ecosystem enabling customers to integrate specialized third-party technology and services into the AppFolio Platform, allowing workflow customization and extension.

products.name: Franchise Resale Stores for Used Apparel and Accessories
products.description: Franchising of retail stores under the Plato’s Closet and Style Encore brands, which buy and sell gently used clothing, shoes, and accessories (primarily for teens, young adults, and women), with a small portion of new merchandise. Stores are operated by franchisees and require in-person evaluation and purchasing of goods from customers.

products.name: Franchise Resale Stores for Used Children’s Goods
products.description: Franchising of Once Upon A Child retail stores, which buy and sell gently used and some new children’s clothing, toys, furniture, equipment, and accessories. Franchisees operate physical stores, purchasing items directly from customers and reselling them at value prices.

products.name: Franchise Resale Stores for Used Sporting Goods and Equipment
products.description: Franchising of Play It Again Sports retail stores, which buy, sell, and trade gently used and new sporting goods, equipment, and accessories for a variety of athletic activities. Franchisees operate physical stores and adjust inventory seasonally and regionally.

products.name: Franchise Resale Stores for Used Musical Instruments and Equipment
products.description: Franchising of Music Go Round retail stores, which buy, sell, and trade gently used and some new musical instruments, speakers, amplifiers, music-related electronics, and accessories. Franchisees operate physical stores and purchase inventory directly from customers.

products.name: E-Commerce Platform for Franchisee Inventory
products.description: Provision of an e-commerce platform that enables franchisees of Music Go Round, Play It Again Sports, and Style Encore to market and sell in-store product inventory online, with options for in-store pickup or shipment. This digital platform supports multi-channel retailing for franchisees.

products.name: Metal Food and Household Packaging
products.description: Manufactured steel and aluminum cans, ends, and closures for food and household products, produced in large-scale metal fabrication plants and delivered globally, primarily serving the consumer staples market.

products.name: Rigid Paper Containers
products.description: Rigid containers made from 100% recycled paperboard, manufactured in dedicated plants and used primarily for food and beverage packaging such as snacks, baked goods, and powdered drinks.

products.name: Industrial Paper Tubes and Cores
products.description: Paper-based tubes and cores produced from recycled fiber, manufactured in industrial plants and used for winding, transporting, and protecting various industrial and consumer products.

products.name: Uncoated Recycled Paperboard
products.description: Uncoated recycled paperboard manufactured in Sonoco’s paper mills, sold to third parties for use in high-end applications such as folding cartons, can board, and laminated structures.

products.name: Paper-Based Protective Packaging and Partitions
products.description: Protective materials and partitions made from recycled fiber, manufactured in industrial facilities and used to safeguard goods during shipping and handling across various end markets.

products.name: Industrial and Specialty Plastics Packaging
products.description: Plastic packaging products manufactured in specialized plants, serving industrial and specialty applications across diverse markets; includes custom and standard plastic packaging solutions.

products.name: Vacation Ownership Interests (VOIs)
products.description: Fee-simple deeded or trust-based timeshare interests allowing customers to purchase the right to use vacation accommodations at branded resorts. Delivered through physical real estate development, acquisition, and sales, with options for annual or biennial use and points-based flexibility.

products.name: Consumer Financing for VOI Purchases
products.description: Origination and servicing of consumer loans to finance customer purchases of VOIs, generating interest income and servicing fees. Requires financial capital, underwriting, and loan servicing infrastructure.

products.name: Resort Management Services
products.description: Operation and management of timeshare resorts on behalf of homeowners’ associations, including day-to-day operations, maintenance, financial management, and personnel oversight. Delivered through in-person management teams under long-term agreements.

products.name: Club Membership and Exchange Programs
products.description: Management and operation of vacation clubs that provide members with reservation, exchange, and leisure travel services, including access to a network of resorts, affiliated properties, and experiential vacation options. Delivered digitally and via call centers, with annual and transaction-based fees.

products.name: Rental of Available Inventory
products.description: Short-term rental of unsold, third-party, or exchange-available timeshare inventory to non-owners and members, generating rental and ancillary revenue. Delivered through direct booking channels and on-property services.

products.name: Ancillary Resort Services (Food, Beverage, Retail, Spa)
products.description: Provision of ancillary services such as food and beverage, retail, and spa offerings at timeshare properties, generating additional revenue from resort guests and renters. Delivered through on-site operations at managed resorts.

products.name: Basic Lithium Compounds
products.description: Development and manufacturing of lithium carbonate, lithium hydroxide, and lithium chloride, primarily through mining and chemical processing, for use in batteries, greases, glass, and other industrial applications.

products.name: Bromine-Based Specialty Chemicals
products.description: Production of bromine and bromine-based chemicals, including elemental bromine, alkyl bromides, inorganic bromides, brominated powdered activated carbon, and bromine fine chemicals, used in fire safety, electronics, water treatment, and food safety, manufactured via extraction from brine and chemical synthesis.

products.name: Lithium Specialties
products.description: Manufacture of specialized lithium chemicals such as butyllithium and lithium aluminum hydride, used in organic synthesis, pharmaceuticals, vitamins, and life sciences, produced through advanced chemical synthesis and purification processes.

products.name: Fire Safety Solutions
products.description: Development and supply of fire safety compounds, primarily brominated flame retardants, used to enhance flame resistance in plastics, electronics, textiles, and insulation, produced via chemical synthesis and compounding.

products.name: Catalysts for Oil Refining (Hydroprocessing and FCC Catalysts)
products.description: Manufacture and supply of hydroprocessing catalysts (HPC) and fluidized catalytic cracking (FCC) catalysts and additives, used in oil refineries to upgrade oil fractions, remove impurities, and improve yields, produced through advanced materials synthesis and formulation.

products.name: Performance Catalyst Solutions (Organometallics and Curatives)
products.description: Production of organometallic co-catalysts (e.g., aluminum, magnesium, and zinc alkyls) and curatives for use in the manufacture of polyolefins, alpha-olefins, and engineered resins, produced via chemical synthesis and supplied to polymer and electronics industries.

products.name: Technical and Recycling Services for Lithium Products
products.description: Provision of technical services related to the handling and use of reactive lithium products, and recycling services for lithium-containing by-products, delivered through specialized technical expertise and processing facilities.

products.name: Cesium and Pyrotechnic Chemicals
products.description: Development and manufacture of cesium products for chemical and pharmaceutical industries, and zirconium, barium, and titanium products for pyrotechnical applications such as airbag initiators, produced via chemical synthesis and materials processing.

products.name: Industrial and Commercial Property Leasing and Management
products.description: Leasing and management of industrial and commercial real estate properties, including warehouses, office buildings, and ground leases, primarily owned or managed by the company. Delivery involves physical property ownership, leasing contracts, and ongoing property management services.

products.name: Mining Royalty Land Leasing
products.description: Leasing of land to mining companies for extraction activities, generating revenue through mining rents or royalties. The company owns large tracts of land and enters into long-term lease agreements with mining operators.

products.name: Real Estate Development and Sale
products.description: Acquisition, entitlement, development, and construction of real estate properties (apartment, retail, industrial, office) for eventual sale, joint venture, or conversion to income-producing assets. Involves land acquisition, construction, and sale or partnership transactions.

products.name: Multifamily and Mixed-Use Property Leasing and Management
products.description: Leasing and management of multifamily residential and mixed-use residential/retail properties, primarily through joint ventures. Involves property ownership, leasing, and ongoing management services for stabilized buildings.
